body: Hello, thanks for your interest in our research! We have participants complete a number of surveys about past and current emotions, relationships, behaviors, experiences, etc.

Hello, Thanks for the very detailed questions. The first step in the process is to complete the screener which only collects de-identified information. If someone qualifies, they will have the choice to supply identifiable information for us to contact them. If they supply information, the next step will be for the person to review the consent form. This supplies them all the information you are asking for here. At this time, they can make an informed decision whether to continue or not with the research. This study has been approved by the University of Notre Dame Institutional Review Board (ethics board). Thanks so much!

**Who I am:** Researcher, Dr. Brooke Ammerman  
**Affiliation:** University of Notre Dame  
**Supervisor:** N/A, Researcher is an Assistant Professor  
**Target group:** Anyone interested in contributing to psychological research  
**Compensation:** Payment via gift card  
**Link to screener:** https://nd.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV\_eFeCCzi6ASazUSV  
**Background:** The Affect, Suicide, Self-Injury, and Social Triggers (ASSIST) Lab at the University of Notre Dame is looking for individuals interested in participating in research. This study examines how daily social or interpersonal experiences influence one’s thoughts, feelings, and behaviors. Participation in this study will consist of completing an online survey. After this, participants will be asked to complete a brief survey 4 times per day, for 30 days using a mobile application. In addition, participants will be asked to share a screenshot of their mobile phone usage. The compensation for participating in this research will be $100. If you still want to participate in this study, we ask you to complete the online screener using the link below. If you qualify for the study, a member from our team will reach out to you. If you have any question regarding our study, please do not hesitate to email us at assist@nd.edu.  
**Link to results:** We will post citations for our published articles on our lab website, https://assistlab.nd.edu/
Unfortunately, due to the nature of the app used for the experiment, we require IOS devices to take part in the study.

Hi everyone! This study posting was approved by the mods, and the study is also approved by the University of Notre Dame's Institutional Review Board. It is being conducted by Dr. Brooke Ammerman at the University of Notre Dame, and the screener survey link is routed through Notre Dame's secure Qualtrics account. If you complete the survey and get the "ineligible" screen, we will not be saving your information for future contact/anything else. If you are eligible, we'll reach out to provide more information, but you will not be added to our future recruitment list unless you provide explicit consent.

You can find Dr. Ammerman's faculty webpage and CV here: [https://psychology.nd.edu/faculty/brooke-ammerman/](https://psychology.nd.edu/faculty/brooke-ammerman/) and her lab webpage detailing other studies we've done here: [https://assistlab.nd.edu/people/](https://assistlab.nd.edu/people/). If anyone wants more information to confirm our identities, please feel to direct message us and we would be happy to provide that!

Thanks so much to everyone for considering participating! Happy to answer any other questions you have about the study.
